messages:
tara: Quick note: the new 'llamabroker' sample (Next + LangChain agent + LlamaIndex docstore) is failing CI on staging. Looks like two separate issues: (1) auth header dropped in SSR fetch when we use the JS SDK on edge, and (2) python eval harness (pytest) shows subtle parity drift on embed shapes.

oliver: Oof. Can you paste the failing logs? small snippets are fine.

tara: From CI logs: ```
Request to /api/agent failed: 401 Unauthorized (missing Authorization)
Server stack: edge-runtime: fetch to https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate returned 401
```
This only happens in the deployed edge instance, not in node dev.

nina: For the embed shape, pytest prints: expected (1, 768) got (768,). Our python pipeline returns flat arrays sometimes because we accidentally call .tolist() on numpy axis=0. Might be our sample's serialization between server <-> client.

oliver: Two tracks then. For the auth: are we using the official JS SDK createClient in the edge handler or a direct fetch? Edge can strip headers if not careful.

tara: We're using createClient in /app/api/agent/route.js (edge). Snippet: ```js
import { createClient } from 'redwood-sdk'
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
export default async function handler(req) {
  const out = await client.chat.completions.create({ model: 'llama-7b', messages: req.json().messages })
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(out))
}
```
No explicit auth header, SDK inserts it. Works locally.

nina: Could be that Vercel edge masks process.env at runtime on warm starts. We saw earlier parity with node edge envs. Try logging client._config.apiKey in staging (scrub before commit) or set RW_KEY via Vercel secret.

tara: I added ephemeral logs to the staging build: it prints the key fine, but downstream request still 401.

oliver: That points to token refresh flow again. Are we using short-lived hosted tokens with automatic refresh? If so, the SDK might try to call the token endpoint from the edge environment which has egress blocked. The refresh fails silently and the SDK doesn't enqueue retries.

nina: Good call. The python harness uses long-lived test token so it never hits refresh. But the JS edge sample does. That would explain env-local vs staging difference.

tara: Proposed mitigation for the sample repo: detect edge runtime and fall back to a server-side refresh proxy or recommend a long-lived token for the starter. Add a small example in README under "Auth in Edge".

oliver: Agreed. Also file an SDK issue for parity: "js-sdk:refresh-fallback-edge". Add a repro that simulates blocked token-refresh endpoint and verifies SDK retries once after re-auth.

nina: For the python embed shape: I can patch the eval harness serializer to always coerce to 2D numpy arrays before sending across wire (np.atleast_2d), and update the sample's example notebook. Should fix the pytest failures.

ci-bot: CI: rerun requested by tara on branch fix/auth-edge-proxy.

tara: I'll push a small PR: - add README section + opt-in RW_EDGE_PROXY=true example - tiny proxy at /api/_refresh that can call refresh from a non-edge runtime - a unit test that asserts 0 401s in a 200-call spike (local emulation)

oliver: For the SDK issue, add a test that runs in the edge runtime emulator with 50 concurrent requests where refresh endpoint is unreachable. SDK should queue a single refresh attempt and retry inflight requests. Right now it appears to let them fail.

nina: ETA: I'll open PRs for both (python harness patch + sample README) today. I can also add a small notebook showing the proper dtype handling for embed vectors.

qa-bot: Test run started: unit (python) + integration (next-edge). Expect ~7 minutes.

ci-bot: CI: integration failed (401 rate 1.8%). Attaching logs to issue #sdk/edge-refresh.

tara: Thanks. I'll merge the proxy PR behind a feature flag to avoid shipping it to everyone. Will also include instructions on how to test locally.

oliver: Good. After Emma/SDK team lands the refresh lock we can remove the proxy pattern and update the sample to the recommended flow.

tara: Filing follow-ups: #1 sample: add README & opt-in proxy; #2 sdk:js add edge refresh mutex & retry; #3 python: coerce embed shapes in eval harness. Assigning tags and owners in the tracker now. Ping me if you want to review the README text. :sparkles:
